## Summary
Yasser Raafat is a former Outlier AI (Scale AI platform) LLM Post-Training Lead who directed 2,000+
expert contributors across RLHF/DPO/SFT campaigns on GPT-4o/4.5, Claude 3.5/4, Gemini 2.x, and Llama
3/4 — a lead, not a reselling marketplace. He is an active frontier-model evaluator at Alignerr. He
also architected and built CoreFusion, a full autonomous agent platform (~1,110 tests), solo as
personal R&D — so his eval work is grounded in real production-agent engineering.

## Verified results
- Cursor fast-apply (Llama-3-70B): ~13x inference speedup, surpassed GPT-4/4o on full-file edit accuracy.
- Perplexity r1-1776: 40,000+ multilingual preference prompts; 100% uncensored vs 85% baseline, scores preserved.
- SWE-bench Verified / SEAL: SFT raised task accuracy +40%, cut processing time 40%, cut defects 35%.
